description: Na₃ScCl₆ is Ilmenite-like structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Cl atoms. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.79-3.15 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ScCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-44°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.70-2.81 Å. Sc is bonded to six Cl atoms to form ScCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-44°. There are a spread of Sc-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.51 Å. There are three inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded to three Na and one Sc atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ClNa₃Sc trigonal pyramids. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded to three Na and one Sc atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ClNa₃Sc trigonal pyramids. In the third Cl site, Cl is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Sc atom.
